schema.description: A5 — Held credentials (DID is subject), each enriched with issuer/schema/ecosystem context.

subjectDid.description: The credential's subject/holder DID — part of the `(subjectDid, id)` record key.
subjectDid.title: traverse_response_DidString

id.description: The credential `id` — part of the `(subjectDid, id)` record key.

digestJCS.description: Informational: the credential's JCS digest, recomputed and ledger-verified by the indexer per [IDX-VT-EVAL-1].

issuedAtTime.description: Effective issuance time: the `created` timestamp of the credential's ledger Digest entry.
issuedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
validFrom.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
anyOf.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

validUntil.description: `null` for open-ended credentials, per the entity table (`timestamp | null`).

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

issuerParticipant.description: Minimal Participant reference. `state` carries the current lifecycle state; non-`ACTIVE` records are retained while referenced per [[TG-ACT-1]] and are returned by traversal with their state. `validatorParticipantId` anchors the `VALIDATED_BY: Participant → Participant` edge (the parent node in the permission tree); it is `null` if and only if `role = ECOSYSTEM` (the chain root, per [[TG-EDGE-4]]).

didId.description: The DID this Participant entry refers to (envelope-derived at ingestion). Identity only; trust state lives on the `Did` node.
didId.title: traverse_response_DidString

anyOf.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account and for `Corporation.policyAddress`; NOT used as a primary key (Corporation, Ecosystem, CredentialSchema, and Participant primary keys are all `uint64` VPR ledger ids).
anyOf.title: traverse_response_Bech32Address

vsOperator.description: `null` until a VS Operator Authorization has been granted for this entry.

validatorParticipantId.description: Stable VPR id of the validator Participant (parent in the permission tree). `null` iff `role = ECOSYSTEM`; non-negative integer otherwise. The graph persists the value as received from the indexer; the role-conditional rule is enforced upstream at the indexer's ingress.

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

issuerParticipant.title: traverse_response_ParticipantRef

digestSri.description: Subresource Integrity digest in the standard `algo-base64` form.
digestSri.title: traverse_response_DigestSri

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

did.description: The Ecosystem's DID (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.did`). Per VPR, several Ecosystem entries MAY share one DID — the primary key remains `id`. Identity only; trust state lives on the `Did` node.
did.title: traverse_response_DidString

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the Corporation that controls this Ecosystem (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.corporation_id`).

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

egf.description: Active Governance Framework (CGF on a Corporation, EGF on an Ecosystem). Mirrors the indexer-side `GovernanceFramework` shape.

activeSince.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
activeSince.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

digestSri.description: Subresource Integrity digest in the standard `algo-base64` form.
digestSri.title: traverse_response_DigestSri

egf.title: traverse_response_GovernanceFramework
